title: 第37章 张亚冬：魏沐拯救了我

第37章 张亚冬：魏沐拯救了我-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

脑子里还在思索从哪里搜索一些歌曲的张亚冬愣住。

停顿一秒后，他微微蹙起眉头，注视着这个年轻人：“你想全部搞定？”

“对。”

魏沐迎着他的目光，回答得没有一丝犹豫：“我已经写了一些歌，老宋和老高都觉得不错。”

张亚冬立刻转过头，用询问的眼神看向坐在一旁的宋柯。

宋柯没说话，只是沉稳地点了点头。

这么牛逼？

他显然有些难以置信。

魏沐才多大？

看样子也就二十一二岁，大学刚毕业。

“你是音乐专业吗？”，他忍不住追问。

“我是上戏04级表演系学生，爱好音乐。”

“爱好音乐。”

这句话让张亚冬一时语塞，竟不知该如何接话。

他从业这么多年，见过太多科班出身、呕心沥血的音乐人，费劲巴拉弄出一张专辑，最后没有溅起一点水花。

他抬头看向宋柯：“老宋，你有那些歌曲吧？”

“我有，存在手机里。”

魏沐举起手。

“好，我先听一下，然后再确定这张专辑的基调。”

不管是不是真的，先验货再说！！

三十分钟后，太合麦田音乐总监的办公室里。

张亚冬放下耳机，长呼一口气。

再次抬头，看向魏沐的眼神充满了感激。

这两年算是他人生的一次滑铁卢。

前年，有人花大价钱请他来为景田制作专辑，还专门找导演宁昊过来拍MV。

为了搞这张专辑，张亚冬很头疼，因为景田基本没有唱歌基础，所以要一点点教。

不仅如此，他还要每天讲笑话，鼓励景田加油录歌。

那个时候，他觉得自己就像一个保姆。

去年年底，景田首张EP《你是谁》发行，扑的毫无水花。

然后就有人批他江郎才尽，花钱不办事。

对此，他不想解释。

媒体都是这样，喜欢捧高踩低，塑造一个神，再把它推倒，狠狠地踩在脚底下。

现在不一样，他遇到了魏沐。

拯救他的人！！

刚才把所有歌曲都听一遍，张亚冬惊呆了。

《偏爱》《此生不换》还有《说散就散》

这三首顶级质量的歌曲，随便拿出来一个都可以当成畅销专辑的主打歌。

现在他遇到一个问题。

把这三首歌放在同一张专辑里面是不是有点浪费？

大致说一下，张亚冬把决定权交给作曲人。

Zhang Yadong, who was still thinking about where to search for some songs, was stunned.

After a second's pause, he frowned slightly and stared at the young man: "You want to do it all?"

"Yes."

Wei Mu met his gaze and answered without any hesitation: "I have written some songs, and both Lao Song and Lao Gao think they are good."

Zhang Yadong immediately turned his head and looked at Song Ke sitting beside him with questioning eyes.

Song Ke didn't speak, but nodded calmly.

So awesome?

He was obviously in disbelief.

How old is Wei Mucai?

He looked to be only twenty-one or twelve years old and had just graduated from college.

"Are you a music major?", he couldn't help but ask.

"I am a grade 04 acting student at the Shanghai Theater Academy, and I love music."

"Love music."

This sentence made Zhang Yadong speechless for a moment, and he didn't know how to answer the question.

He has been in the industry for so many years and has seen too many musicians who have a professional background and work hard to produce an album, but in the end there is no splash.

He looked up at Song Ke: "Old Song, do you have those songs?"

"I have it, it's on my phone."

Wei Mu raised his hand.

“Okay, let me listen to it first and then decide on the tone of the album.”

Regardless of whether it is true or not, check the goods first!!

Thirty minutes later, in the office of the music director of Taihe Maitian.

Zhang Yadong put down his headphones and took a long breath.

He raised his head again and looked at Wei Mu with eyes filled with gratitude.

The past two years can be regarded as a Waterloo in his life.

The year before last, someone paid a lot of money to hire him to produce an album for Jingtian, and even hired director Ning Hao to shoot the MV.

In order to make this album, Zhang Yadong had a headache because Jingtian basically had no singing foundation, so he had to teach him little by little.

Not only that, he also told jokes every day and encouraged Jingtian to record songs.

At that time, he felt like a nanny.

At the end of last year, Jingtian's first EP "Who Are You" was released, and it was a hit.

Then some people criticized him for using up his talents and spending money instead of getting things done.

He didn't want to explain this.

The media is like this, they like to flatter others and create a god, then tear them down and trample them severely.

It's different now, he met Wei Mu.

Save his people!!

Zhang Yadong was shocked after listening to all the songs just now.

"Preference", "Never Change in This Life" and "Let's Break Up"

These three top-quality songs, any one of them can be regarded as the title song of a best-selling album.

Now he has a problem.

Is it a waste to put these three songs on the same album?

To put it roughly, Zhang Yadong leaves the decision-making power to the composer.
